name: mirage
text: Not sure yet, and my last answer was too confident. Your screenshot shows two numbers that differ by only $2.5: -$53.08 all-time (6,261 bets and bids with a result) and -$50.57 since Sep 29 (6,249 settled). So all-time is built from the bets' results, not summed from the wallet days as I said. The $200+ you sometimes see is, I think, Novig's own ledger line for the subaccount (the engine read it at -$255 on Nov 18). That is a different total, and I can't yet explain a $200 gap between it and the Tracker's. I'll trace it next and write down which one matches your real wallet. Until then, don't treat either as exact.
